title: Tri-City Herald death notices for July 29, 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
6 hours ago Losing someone isn't easy and there are many steps to be taken in handling their affairs. Here are five reminders that you may not have remembered in the midst of it all.
Kamaria Roberts
Ann E. Wallace Ann Elizabeth Wallace, 70, of West Richland, died July 27 in Richland.
She was born in Grants Pass, Ore., and lived in the Tri-Cities area for 22 years.
Einan’s at Sunset, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
Theodore Jayson Scott Hinderer Theodore Jayson Scott Hinderer, the newborn son of Breanne and Cody Hinderer, died July 24 in Kennewick.
Einan’s at Hillcrest, Kennewick, is in charge of arrangements.
Wendy M. Dunn Wendy M. Dunn, 61, of Pasco, died July 11 at Chaplaincy Hospice House.
She was born in Kennewick and was a lifelong Tri-Citian.
She was a homemaker.
Einan’s at Hillcrest, Pasco, is in charge of arrangements.
Robert D. Rice Robert Don Rice, 88, of Pasco, died July 24 in Pasco.
He was born in Boswell, Okla., and lived in Pasco for 38 years.
He was a retired ordained minister.
Compassionate Cremation Society, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
June M. Omel June Marlene Omel, 81, of Richland, died July 27 in Richland.
She lived in Richland for 50 years.
Einan’s at Sunset, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
Richard L. Matthews Sr. Richard Lamar Matthews Sr., 76, of Pasco, died July 17 in Pasco.
He was born in Angleton, Texas, and lived in the Tri-Cities for 49 years.
He was a retired welder.
Compassionate Cremation Society, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
Patricia J. Strohn Patricia Jean Strohn, 72, of Kennewick, died July 23 in Kennewick.
She was born in Hollister, Calif., and lived in Kennewick for two years.
She was a retired bookkeeper.
Einan’s at Hillcrest, Kennewick, is in charge of arrangements.
Finis M. Desoto Finis Marie Desoto, 75, of Benton City, died July 24 in Benton City.
Einan’s at Sunset, Richland, is in charge of arrangements.
